SELECTED_INDEX: 8
CONFIDENCE: 0.28
EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows (i) a very intense ν(C≡N) band at 2266 cm⁻¹, requiring at least one nitrile group – present in candidates 1, 2, 3, 6, 7 and 8. (ii) A strong N–H/O–H‐type X–H stretch at 3208 cm⁻¹; only candidate 8 contains an N–H bond, while the others with nitrile do not contain any X–H capable of giving a band in this region. (iii) Multiple C–H stretches at 2854–3022 cm⁻¹ agree with the several aliphatic C–H bonds in 8. (iv) Ether (C–O–C) stretching bands are expected near 1020–1180 cm⁻¹, matching the observed 1028, 1058, 1163 and 1175 cm⁻¹ peaks; candidate 8 is the only nitrile-bearing molecule that also has an ether (–O–) function. (v) Ring‐breathing/COC deformation modes of a five-membered heterocycle commonly appear near 900–950 cm⁻¹ and ~720 cm⁻¹, matching the 898, 939 and 720 cm⁻¹ peaks. Taken together, the simultaneous presence of a nitrile, an N–H stretch and cyclic ether vibrations is uniquely compatible with N#CC1(N)CC2COC21 (candidate 8); no other candidate contains this set of functional groups.
